title: RequirementsCatalog
description: Feature-level catalog of requirements for a reusable component, screen, or script. Cross-project; not tied to a single domain.

specId.description: Stable feature id, usually the folder basename (e.g. articulation-section).

config.description: Declarative knobs the feature exposes so requirements stay reusable (props, ports, section ids).

dependsOn.description: Other catalog specId values this feature composes (e.g. screens depending on components).
